parameters.name: allow_force_push
parameters.description: Whether or not to allow force pushes to the protected branch. Choices: false true

parameters.name: api_job_token
parameters.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_oauth_token
parameters.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

parameters.name: code_owner_approval_required
parameters.description: Whether or not to require code owner approval to push. Choices: false true

parameters.name: merge_access_levels
parameters.description: Access levels allowed to merge. Choices: "maintainer" ← (default) "developer" "nobody"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the branch that needs to be protected. Can make use a wildcard character for like production/* or just have main or develop as value.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The path and name of the project.

parameters.name: push_access_level
parameters.description: Access levels allowed to push. Choices: "maintainer" ← (default) "developer" "nobody"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create or delete protected branch. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create protected branch on main
  community.general.gitlab_protected_branch:
    api_url: https://gitlab.com
    api_token: secret_access_token
    project: "dj-wasabi/collection.general"
    name: main
    merge_access_levels: maintainer
    push_access_level: nobody
